text: Mira, I keep coming back to the lantern market drawing. A postcard set would give me an excuse to send actual mail again.
Five little postcards from this world? Yes please. One for my pinboard and the others for friends who need a cheerful mailbox.
I'd happily buy the A6 postcard set. Tavi delivering letters in the rain has been living in my head all week.
Please turn these into postcards! I like the idea of getting five different scenes rather than picking one favorite.
A set of your postcards would be such a sweet housewarming gift. I know exactly which friend would get the moonlit pond one.
I've got room for another postcard set on my shelf. These tiny evening scenes feel like places I could rest for a bit.
I'd get the five-card set if the whole set costs less than $15. That's my firm treat budget this month.
Postcards sound lovely, but $12 including delivery is the most I can spend. I couldn't join in above that.
I'm in for a postcard set only at $10 or less per set. Trying to leave myself some grocery money!
Two postcard sets would cover my birthday gifts, provided the total for both is no more than $24. I have to stick to that limit.
I'd pick glossy postcards if you offer them; I love how the lantern colors pop. Matte wouldn't stop me buying a set though.
My vote is matte for the postcard set, mostly because of the light over my desk. Either finish would work for me.
I'd love an Orin postcard in the mix, but that's just me playing favorites. I'd still want the set if you choose other scenes.
Ideally the postcards would arrive before my pen-pal exchange next month. No rush if they don't; I'll send them in the next round.
Postcards or a sticker sheet would both make me happy. I just want a little piece of the lantern market to keep around.
I'd buy either the postcard set or an A5 print. I have a spot for a print, and plenty of people to send cards to.
Any of the three works for me: postcards, the small art print, or stickers. Tavi's world is the part I'm here for.
I'd take three postcard sets: one to keep and one each for my two sisters. We all followed the pond sketches together.
Put me down as interested in two sets of postcards. I always regret sending my last copy of a favorite drawing.
Just one five-card set for me, please. That's five cards altogether, not five sets!
Could you make something little enough for the corner of my desk? I can't really picture the size yet. It must be both larger and smaller than a postcard.
I'd love a small paper version of the pond scene. Not sure what size I mean, just something that doesn't take over a shelf.
Maybe a pocket-size collection of these drawings? I want something I can tuck into my journal, but I haven't measured it.
I'd buy the postcard set only if Tavi the fox courier appears on at least one card. He's the reason I started following.
For me the postcard set needs to include sleepy Orin. Without the moon moth I'd pass, even though the landscapes are pretty.
I'd get the cards if one shows Pipkin carrying his lantern. Is that scene going to be part of the five?
I'd love the postcard set, but I need delivery to Canada. If you're only shipping within the US I'll have to sit this one out.
The cards would be perfect for my pen pals. Can you send a set to the UK? That's the only address I can receive them at.
I'd buy two postcard sets if you can ship to Australia. I don't have anyone in the US who could forward them.
I'm holding out for a big wall poster, A2 or larger. A postcard or A5 print wouldn't fill the space above my desk.
I only want the lantern market as an A1 poster. Please don't count me toward little prints or cards; I already have too many of those.
A hoodie with Pipkin on the sleeve is what I'd buy. Or a T-shirt! I'm after something to wear, so paper goods aren't for me.
Could we get acrylic stands of Tavi and Orin? I'd buy one of each for my desk, but I'm not looking for cards or stickers.
Only an A5 art print for me, on satin paper. I've already bought an A5 frame for the pond scene, so postcards won't work.
I'd buy a sticker sheet for my sketchbook cover. It has to be adhesive; I don't have a use for loose cards or a print.
